consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices
controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems

facts.title: stored energy found after isolation of PSV-7104

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PRESSURE_EQUIPMENT_INSPECTION: the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PRESSURE_RELIEF_DEVICE_INTEGRITY: the setting, testing and sealing of pressure relief devices was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

Control STEAM_SYSTEM_WARM_THROUGH: the controlled draining, venting and warm-through of steam systems was in place but did not perform, and the root cause analysis classified this as an individual or team action.

recommendations: Restore the in-service inspection of pressure equipment on PSV-7104 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in inspecting pressure equipment, specifically performing in-service and hydrostatic inspection. PSV-7104 (tank relief and vent devices) is in service for tank overpressure and vacuum protection. The task proceeded during transfer operations while the in-service inspection of pressure equipment had degraded below its design intent. The pressure energy involved is held as hydraulic accumulator, and the recorded presentation was jet release, stored-energy discharge, rupture.
response.summary: On 10 April 2013 a hazard report was recorded on PSV-7104 at Cape Verity Export Terminal during transfer operations; pressure energy held as hydraulic accumulator was not released.
